t: 朱塞佩·加里波第进入那不勒斯。
te: Giuseppe Garibaldi enters Naples.
dz: 意大利统一：朱塞佩·加里波第进入那不勒斯。
de: Unification of Italy: Giuseppe Garibaldi enters Naples.

t: 摩门教定居者屠杀了一列和平出行的火车的大部分成员.
te: Mormon settlers slaughter most members of a peaceful emigrant wagon train.
dz: Meadows山大屠杀:摩门教定居者屠杀了一列和平出行的火车的大部分成员.
de: Mountain Meadows massacre: Mormon settlers slaughter most members of a peaceful emigrant wagon train.

t: 赛马运河落成.
te: The Saimaa Canal is inaugurated.
dz: 赛马运河落成.
de: The Saimaa Canal is inaugurated.

t: 多姆·佩德罗一世宣布巴西在圣保罗的伊皮兰加布鲁克海岸从葡萄牙独立.
te: Dom Pedro I declares Brazil independent from Portugal on the shores of the Ipiranga Brook in São Paulo.
dz: 多姆·佩德罗一世宣布巴西在圣保罗的伊皮兰加布鲁克海岸从葡萄牙独立.
de: Dom Pedro I declares Brazil independent from Portugal on the shores of the Ipiranga Brook in São Paulo.

t: 瑞典卡尔三世-挪威被加冕为挪威国王,位于特隆赫姆.
te: Carl III of Sweden–Norway is crowned king of Norway, in Trondheim.
dz: 瑞典卡尔三世-挪威被加冕为挪威国王,位于特隆赫姆.
de: Carl III of Sweden–Norway is crowned king of Norway, in Trondheim.

t: 拿破仑战争中最血腥的一战"波罗地诺之战"在莫斯科附近展开并取得法国的胜利.
te: The Battle of Borodino, the bloodiest battle of the Napoleonic Wars, is fought near Moscow and results in a French vict…
dz: 法国入侵俄罗斯:拿破仑战争中最血腥的一战"波罗地诺之战"在莫斯科附近展开并取得法国的胜利.
de: French invasion of Russia: The Battle of Borodino, the bloodiest battle of the Napoleonic Wars, is fought near Moscow and results in a French victory.

t: 法国入侵英属西印度群岛的多米尼克，而英国甚至还没有意识到法国卷入了这场战争。
te: France invades Dominica in the British West Indies, before Britain is even aware of France's involvement in the war.
dz: 美国独立战争：法国入侵英属西印度群岛的多米尼克，而英国甚至还没有意识到法国卷入了这场战争。
de: American Revolutionary War: France invades Dominica in the British West Indies, before Britain is even aware of France's involvement in the war.

t: 据美国殖民报告,以斯拉·李使出"龟"中世界上第一次潜艇出击,试图将一枚定时炸弹附在纽约港的"鹰…
te: According to American colonial reports, Ezra Lee makes the world's first submarine attack in the Turtle, attempting to …
dz: 据美国殖民报告,以斯拉·李使出"龟"中世界上第一次潜艇出击,试图将一枚定时炸弹附在纽约港的"鹰"号(HMS Eagle)船体上(英国没有关于这次出击的记录).
de: According to American colonial reports, Ezra Lee makes the world's first submarine attack in the Turtle, attempting to attach a time bomb to the hull of HMS Eagle in New York Harbor (no British records of this attack exist).

t: 选举斯坦尼斯瓦夫·奥古斯特·波尼亚托夫斯基为波兰-立陶宛联邦的最后一位统治者.
te: Election of Stanisław August Poniatowski as the last ruler of the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth.
dz: 选举斯坦尼斯瓦夫·奥古斯特·波尼亚托夫斯基为波兰-立陶宛联邦的最后一位统治者.
de: Election of Stanisław August Poniatowski as the last ruler of the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth.

t: 在波尔图斯暴动后,一群暴徒在爱丁堡的托尔布斯监狱和林奇斯·约翰·波尔图斯(英语:John Po…
te: Following the Porteous Riots, a mob storms the Tolbooth prison in Edinburgh and lynches John Porteous.
dz: 在波尔图斯暴动后,一群暴徒在爱丁堡的托尔布斯监狱和林奇斯·约翰·波尔图斯(英语:John Porteous (film))暴发了风暴.
de: Following the Porteous Riots, a mob storms the Tolbooth prison in Edinburgh and lynches John Porteous.

t: 法国王国和神圣罗马帝国之间的巴登条约得到批准.
te: The treaty of Baden between the kingdom of France and the Holy Roman Empire is ratified.
dz: 法国王国和神圣罗马帝国之间的巴登条约得到批准.
de: The treaty of Baden between the kingdom of France and the Holy Roman Empire is ratified.

t: 都灵之围结束,导致法军从北意大利撤军.
te: Siege of Turin ends, leading to the withdrawal of French forces from North Italy.
dz: 西班牙继承之战:都灵之围结束,导致法军从北意大利撤军.
de: War of the Spanish Succession: Siege of Turin ends, leading to the withdrawal of French forces from North Italy.

t: Henry Every犯下了历史上最有利可图的海盗袭击行动之一,俘获了"大莫卧儿"(Ganj-…
te: Henry Every perpetrates one of the most profitable pirate raids in history with the capture of the Grand Mughal ship Ga…
dz: Henry Every犯下了历史上最有利可图的海盗袭击行动之一,俘获了"大莫卧儿"(Ganj-i-Sawai)号船. 作为回应,奥兰热布皇帝威胁要结束所有在印度的英国贸易.
de: Henry Every perpetrates one of the most profitable pirate raids in history with the capture of the Grand Mughal ship Ganj-i-Sawai. In response, Emperor Aurangzeb threatens to end all English trading in India.

t: 大约 15,000 名汉族农民和民兵反抗荷兰对台湾的统治。
te: Around 15,000 Han farmers and militia rebel against Dutch rule on Taiwan.
dz: 大约 15,000 名汉族农民和民兵反抗荷兰对台湾的统治。
de: Around 15,000 Han farmers and militia rebel against Dutch rule on Taiwan.

t: "南安普敦条约"使英格兰和荷兰共和国结盟反对西班牙.
te: The Treaty of Southampton makes an alliance between England and the Dutch Republic against Spain.
dz: "南安普敦条约"使英格兰和荷兰共和国结盟反对西班牙.
de: The Treaty of Southampton makes an alliance between England and the Dutch Republic against Spain.

t: 克克科拉镇(瑞典语:Karleby)由瑞典国王古斯塔夫斯·阿道弗斯所建立.
te: The town of Kokkola (Swedish: Karleby) is founded by King Gustavus Adolphus of Sweden.
dz: 克克科拉镇(瑞典语:Karleby)由瑞典国王古斯塔夫斯·阿道弗斯所建立.
de: The town of Kokkola (Swedish: Karleby) is founded by King Gustavus Adolphus of Sweden.

t: 托马斯·霍华德(Thomas Howard,4th Duke of Norfolk)因出演了里…
te: Thomas Howard, 4th Duke of Norfolk, is arrested for his role in the Ridolfi plot to assassinate Queen Elizabeth I of En…
dz: 托马斯·霍华德(Thomas Howard,4th Duke of Norfolk)因出演了里多尔菲暗杀英格兰女王伊丽莎白一世的阴谋而被捕,取而代之的是苏格兰女王玛丽.
de: Thomas Howard, 4th Duke of Norfolk, is arrested for his role in the Ridolfi plot to assassinate Queen Elizabeth I of England and replace her with Mary, Queen of Scots.

t: 由西班牙腓特烈二世出使至马耳他大围城的所谓"大索克索"("大解脱")到达.
te: Arrival of the so-called Grande Soccorso ("great relief") by Philip II of Spain to the Great Siege of Malta.
dz: 由西班牙腓特烈二世出使至马耳他大围城的所谓"大索克索"("大解脱")到达.
de: Arrival of the so-called Grande Soccorso ("great relief") by Philip II of Spain to the Great Siege of Malta.

t: 纪尧姆·德·诺加雷特代表法国的腓力四世将教宗博尼法斯八世俘虏.
te: Guillaume de Nogaret takes Pope Boniface VIII prisoner on behalf of Philip IV of France.
dz: 纪尧姆·德·诺加雷特代表法国的腓力四世将教宗博尼法斯八世俘虏.
de: Guillaume de Nogaret takes Pope Boniface VIII prisoner on behalf of Philip IV of France.

t: 神圣罗马皇帝弗雷德里克二世在阿克里登陆,并开始了第六次十字军东征,使耶路撒冷王国得到和平的恢复.
te: Holy Roman Emperor Frederick II lands in Acre, and starts the Sixth Crusade, which results in a peaceful restoration of…
dz: 神圣罗马皇帝弗雷德里克二世在阿克里登陆,并开始了第六次十字军东征,使耶路撒冷王国得到和平的恢复.
de: Holy Roman Emperor Frederick II lands in Acre, and starts the Sixth Crusade, which results in a peaceful restoration of the Kingdom of Jerusalem.

t: 阿尔苏夫之战：英格兰理查一世在阿尔苏夫击败萨拉丁。
te: Battle of Arsuf: Richard I of England defeats Saladin at Arsuf.
dz: 第三次十字军东征：阿尔苏夫之战：英格兰理查一世在阿尔苏夫击败萨拉丁。
de: Third Crusade: Battle of Arsuf: Richard I of England defeats Saladin at Arsuf.

t: 红衣主教罗兰多·班迪内利被选为教宗亚历山大三世,促使红衣主教奥克塔维亚诺·蒙蒂切利同日被选为安…
te: Cardinal Rolando Bandinelli is elected Pope Alexander III, prompting the election of Cardinal Octaviano Monticelli as A…
dz: 红衣主教罗兰多·班迪内利被选为教宗亚历山大三世,促使红衣主教奥克塔维亚诺·蒙蒂切利同日被选为安提波佩·维克多四世.
de: Cardinal Rolando Bandinelli is elected Pope Alexander III, prompting the election of Cardinal Octaviano Monticelli as Antipope Victor IV the same day.

t: 施塔默尔人路易被教宗约翰八世加冕为西弗朗西亚国王.
te: Louis the Stammerer is crowned as king of West Francia by Pope John VIII.
dz: 施塔默尔人路易被教宗约翰八世加冕为西弗朗西亚国王.
de: Louis the Stammerer is crowned as king of West Francia by Pope John VIII.
